Episode 171. Under the Imperial Palace...(1)
As soon as Dante's order fell, the vassals' faces turned pale. They had never seen Dante break his word once he said it.
"Yo, Your Highness!?"
"Destroy the Imperial Palace!?"
"Are you saying this should be done right now?"
Those who were careful to shut their mouths under the pressure raised their voices in protest.
"Indeed. Any objections?"
"This castle holds thousands of years of the empire's history! You can't simply say you'll eradicate it!"
"Your Highness, even though many from the Bement family have betrayed the empire, the Imperial Palace belongs to the empire, not the royal family."
"The empire's property....."
Dante's eyes narrowed.

"Even if this incident hadn't occurred, I had been considering downsizing the Imperial Palace at some point. How many people and taxes does it take to maintain this unnecessarily grand golden castle?"
"Your Highness! We know that you trust Lord Jin. However, isn't this just a hunch when deciding such a significant matter?"
"By the time a hunch becomes certain, it's too late. If not just one assassin but an army of chaos springs out of the unidentified burrow, how will you deal with it then?"
"Enough! I have no intention of reversing my decision, so accept it. A castle like this, if it's for the security of the empire, I'll destroy it ten times, a hundred times."
At his sharp voice, the vassals finally shut their mouths. Surely, a reprimand would have followed had they said another word.
Jin thought Dante's imperial aspect was still admirable, and that this decision was a hundred times correct.
However, he felt that if he stepped in, things might look better.
'Even though they don't know Dante, all the vassals are deeply loyal to the empire. But they're dissatisfied with overwork and pressure.'
Jin cleared his throat.
"Hmm. Would it be alright if the Barmel Alliance formally expressed one opinion on the evacuation of the Imperial Palace?"
"Speak, Lord Jin."

"As Lord MacGill said a moment ago, the prophet's burrow is merely a hunch. Also, as His Highness said, it is an irreversible issue once it becomes certain, and I believe His Highness will never falter."
"Shouldn't you dissuade His Highness......?"

"How can I stop something that the empire's vassals cannot? Instead, the Barmel Alliance, who first brought up the burrow issue, also intends to take responsibility for the evacuation of the Imperial Palace in its own way. As an ally, that is."
The ministers exchanged glances and murmured among themselves.
Jin looked at them with a smile.
His smile was purely benevolent, but the ministers worried about what kind of move the 12th rider was planning to make.

"Currently, the Free State of Tikan possesses the world's highest level of defense. It is armed with various cutting-edge technologies, along with improved magic cannons looted from the previous royal family."
"Are you suggesting that you would share these technologies with us?"

"Yes, I will share more than before. We will send Amella, who has contributed the most to the improvement of Tikan's defense, and other necessary personnel, and we will also partially support the necessary core materials for development from the Barmel Alliance side. This will apply regardless of the existence of the underground tunnel, starting from the moment a new castle is built to be the new center of the empire after the evacuation of the Imperial Castle."
The ministers thought the next topic would be about what he would get from the Empire, now that Jin had shown his hand.

"In addition, we will also support the defense of the entire empire, not just the new castle, and the technology for flying warships will also be shared. I believe this will be sufficient compensation for demolishing a symbol of the old era."
However, when he continued to speak about additional support, the ministers were puzzled as to why Jin was doing this.

"The Barmel Alliance and the Empire are allies, and the Emperor and I are close friends, and the world is at risk of destruction in front of chaos. I hope you all understand that I'm not trying to take something from the Empire in return for my support."
Even if he did not destroy the Imperial Castle, Jin had planned to do so from the beginning.

Now that Rosa has become a demon, and even after she is defeated someday. The crisis of the Empire and Dante was no different from the crisis of the Barmel Alliance and Jin. Even after Rosa is defeated, there are still Ziphel and Kinsello.
"Thanks to your discomfort, Jin Kyeong is receiving an unexpected gift. The benefits offered by Jin Kyeong are incomparable to the likes of this Imperial Castle."
Dante also knew about this, but he made it more interesting.
The ministers were confused whether they should like or dislike it, but in a few days, they came to think of the former.
Amella came to the Empire and showed various equipment directly. The various artifacts developed by Kwal naturally far exceeded the common sense of the ministers.
"....The evacuation is not proceeding as quickly as I thought. I'm worried that it's taking too much of your time."
It's a task to erase the biggest building on the ground. It wasn't a problem that could be solved in a day or two.

Jin and Dante were going around the demolition site looking for the underground tunnel. High-ranking officials and substitutes who knew all the secrets of the castle combined each other's information to guess the location of the underground tunnel, and whenever a new location was found, Jin personally checked the place.
Because Jin was the only one who could properly detect the soul energy.
"It's okay. I've dealt with most of the urgent matters, so your safety is the most important issue now. And this is quite fast. No matter how, you can't just demolish it as much as possible."

"I'm grateful that you say that. By the way, Joshua Runkandel is suspected of being the one who sent an assassin to the royal family.... If that's really the case, that bastard is like a cockroach. He was deprived of his rider's rights, became a cripple, and still came back."

“Even if he's not quite as powerful as Sister Runthia, he probably got stronger. That doesn't seem to be much of a problem, but I'm worried about who the swordsman he handed over to the royal family might be."
It was difficult to guess who the assassin handed over from Runcandel to Ailan Biment.
'Among those I've faced in the Garden of Swords so far, there won't be many who could defeat Dante now.'
Including Rosa herself, Padruler Runcandel, Lionel, and Runthia.
However, Runthia is currently unable to appear due to his wounds, and the destructive swordsmanship of Padruler and Lionel were not suitable for assassination at all.

'Of course, there will be more people who can defeat Dante, and if their goal is not assassination but surprise attack through the tunnel. The Empire would suffer catastrophic damage with just them...'
-<Runcandel's... Runcandel handed over a monster to Ailan Biment, a prince of the Biment royal family, commanding him to kill Dante Hyran, the Lord of the Imperial Sword.>
Handed over a monster.
That part kept bothering Jin. '...Runcandel' was blanked out due to lack of achievement in recording magic or for other reasons, but the ambiguous expression 'monster' was clearly stated.

It was unclear whether he described it as a monster because the target's martial prowess was great, or it referred to a strange existence created by chaos, or something else. Until they faced it, they couldn't know.
Above all.
The reason Jin kept considering the possibility of assassination more than invasion was because the term 'monster' was singular.
"Do you think it's more likely to be the old head of the Runcandel family or one of the Ten Knights you met?"
"That might be the case."
Now that they had started dismantling the Imperial Palace, a ominous feeling as if something heavy had fallen on him clouded Jin's mind.
'I don't know why I feel so upset. There's nothing confirmed yet...'
Perhaps it was because he was angry thinking about the Garden of Swords being dyed in chaos, Jin tried hard to suppress the sticky ominous sensation.
Boom...!
The sound of buildings being demolished echoed from all around.

Days had passed, only intact buildings were being demolished with no results, and without the absolute support of the people towards Dante and Jin, the atmosphere in the capital would have been much more uneasy.
Jin, Dante, and the pillars of the Empire were hoping that the tunnel wouldn't be found.
However, exactly twelve days after the demolition began.
Jin proved his speculation correct.
"It's the aura of chaos, Dante."
"Have you found it!?"
"It's around the third reality room on the first floor. Prepare the troops, let's go right away."
As soon as the third reality room began to be dismantled, the hidden aura of chaos was revealed. No one else could feel it.
Even after inspecting the site, the third reality room being demolished showed no unusual circumstances.
Swoosh-!
When Jin drew out the Bradamante, Dante and the waiting soldiers took up defensive positions.
As the blade imbued with spiritual energy cut a straight line into the floor of the 3rd reality, everyone who saw this could only gasp in surprise.
'What on earth!'
'There really is a tunnel under the imperial palace…!'

What was revealed as the floor was cut by the sacred sword was not the cross-section of a stratum or the appearance of a pile of earth and stones, but the spiritual energy in the form of a black well.
The entrance to a tunnel large enough for about a hundred people to enter at once was revealed.
"How could we not know anything while such a thing was being formed under the Imperial Palace?"
"When the Prophet made a tunnel in the Sota Desert, the Zifl didn't notice at all. I hoped it wasn't there, but it turned out."
Jin looked at Dante and the soldiers.

"There's a high chance there are more entrances. Now that the existence of the tunnel is confirmed, speed up the demolition and evacuate the nearby citizens as planned. It would be best for you and me to go in and check."
Nodding his head, Dante. The two men went straight into the tunnel, and the rest carried out their assigned roles.
The tunnel was surprisingly deep without the ground collapsing, but unlike the tunnels Jin had experienced in the past, it was not that complicated.

Even when he reached the end of the underground, Jin was engulfed in a disgusting and ominous premonition. He wasn't afraid of an unknown enemy, but for some reason, he broke into a cold sweat and his heartbeat sped up.
"Are you okay?"
"Ah, it turns out that it was obvious. I've been feeling strangely bad since the beginning of the investigation. I don't know why. It's not enough to worry about……."
At that moment.
His spine suddenly became chilly. He hadn't felt a special energy, but he had a feeling, no, he was sure that if he moved wrong now, he would cut deep somewhere in his body.
Dante also felt the same crisis a beat later than Jin.
And the only person in the world who could make two people tense without any sign at all is a single person.
A figure known as 'Salsin' among the assassins.
'No way……!'
Swish-!
A single sword swept past the two at the same time. Dante was slightly scratched on the back, and Jin narrowly escaped.
And the moment he retaliated and made eye contact with the person who ambushed him, Jin could identify the ominous premonition that had been tormenting him.
"Yona... sister."
Jin could only grit his teeth as he saw her charging at him again.
